mapper.insert: insert into sale_orders (house_id, sale_time, customer, total_weight, unit_price, total_amount, remark, request_id, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{saleTime}, #{customer}, #{totalWeight}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{remark}, #{requestId}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select id, house_id, sale_time, customer, total_weight, unit_price, total_amount, remark, request_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from sale_orders where house_id = #{houseId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1

select id, house_id, sale_time, customer, total_weight, unit_price, total_amount, remark, request_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from sale_orders where house_id = #{houseId} and id = #{id} limit 1
